newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB considers Formula One stake - papers.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB considers Formula One stake - papers.

text.p: British Sky Broadcasting Plc is considering buying a stake in Formula One, the international motor racing business expected to flotate on the UK stockmarket later this year, newspapers said.
BSkyB and Bernie Ecclestone, the head of Formula One, are thought to have discussed a deal, even though no formal approach is thought to have been made by BSkyB, the Independent on Sunday said.

BSkyB would take a stake in Formula One and gain the right to show Granc Prix racing on pay-per-view TV in the UK next year, the newspaper said, quoting a source close to the banking syndicate formed help to sell the shares. This will become possible when BSkyB starts its planned digital satellite TV service next year.
